idh.reasoning: The high T2-FLAIR mismatch measurements favor an IDH-mutant diffuse astrocytic tumor, and the frontal/cortical location is also compatible with IDH-mutant glioma. Against IDH mutation, the age of 60 years, marked enhancement, substantial enhancing volume, necrotic component, large edema burden, midline-crossing enhancement/edema, ependymal invasion, and mass effect are all features often seen with aggressive IDH-wildtype glioblastoma. Because the T2-FLAIR mismatch signal is unusually strong but is counterbalanced by age and high-grade aggressive morphology, the best estimate is IDH-mutant with only moderate confidence.
